Teseq NSG 438 Overview 
The EMC Shop stocks Teseq NSG 438's for rental, with years of ezperience we service the guns and help customers keep testing while senting their ESD gun to us for repair or calibration. 
The Teseq NSG 438 ESD Simulator System (formerly by Schaffner) is one of the most commonly requested 30 kV ESD guns in the commercial electronic, automotive and military industries. ESD Guns stocks calibrated NSG 438's as well as an assortment of discharge networks and accessories for unique test applications. 
Order a Teseq NSG 438 30kV ESD Simulator Gun for precompliance or certification testing to obtain UL & CE Marking in a fast and efficient manner. NSG 438 comprehensively fulfills virtually all international standard requirements. Based on over 60 optional discharge networks, the NSG 438 can meet any of today’s automotive manufacturers’ standards.
